answer: The forge index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1545 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the meadow. Flooding registration pushes an copycat to the back of the oasis queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. Slashing removes 56 percent at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
